newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Soriana a long-term buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Soriana a long-term buy.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Serfin has initiated coverage of Mexican retail chain Organizacion Soriana with a long-term buy recommendation.
-- Analyst Ignacio Hipolito wrote in research report on Friday that the recommendation was based on Soriana's positive first quarter earnings report.

-- "We look for the company to continue to report favorable numbers over the long term. In the light of its current price, we regard the stock as fairly valued, but expect it to slightly outperform the market," Hipolito wrote.
